title: Yankari: Monolingual Yoruba Dataset
measurement_description: Evaluation of religious bias and overrepresentation of religious content in existing Yoruba language datasets, and the purposeful exclusion of such texts during the creation of a new dataset to ensure a more balanced and ethically sourced corpus.
findings: Existing Yoruba datasets, such as Yorùbá Text C3 and the Wura dataset, are heavily skewed towards religious content, particularly Christian texts from sources like the Bible and JW300. The paper argues this overrepresentation is ethically problematic, reflecting a legacy of colonialism, potentially illegal due to source restrictions (JW300), and limits the utility of these datasets for general NLP tasks. The presented Yankari dataset was created to address this gap by explicitly excluding religious sources to provide a more balanced and representative corpus of the Yoruba language.
